title: Restriction compatibility for completed rational evaluation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and a scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], its completed integral coefficient sheaf $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and the integral operations of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. For an object $U$ of this site let $j_U^*$ denote restriction to its slice [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and form the operations on the slice by the same construction with the restricted coefficient sheaves $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}|_U$ and $(A_{E,n})_X|_U$. For $K,M\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], restriction commutes with derived reduction modulo $\varpi_E^n$, and $j_U^*K,j_U^*M$ are derived complete on the slice, i.e. satisfy the condition of [def-weil-derived-complete] for the reduction towers formed with the restricted coefficient sheaves. Restriction commutes with completed derived tensor and derived internal Hom: there are natural comparison isomorphisms $j_U^*(K\widehat\otimes^L M)\cong j_U^*K\widehat\otimes^L j_U^*M$ and $j_U^*R\mathcal Hom(K,M)\cong R\mathcal Hom(j_U^*K,j_U^*M)$. The first comparison identifies the shifted cones of $1-s$ on the countable products of reductions in the completed tensor construction. These comparisons preserve the coefficient unit and identify restriction of the evaluation comparison $R\mathcal Hom(K,\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X})\widehat\otimes^L M\to R\mathcal Hom(K,M)$ with the evaluation comparison for $j_U^*K,j_U^*M$, compatibly with successive restriction along $V\to U$. Consequently, after passing to the scalar localizations at $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization] of the $\mathcal O_E$-linear derived categories of module sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and on the slice, restriction carries the image of the evaluation comparison for $K,M$ to the image of the evaluation comparison for $j_U^*K,j_U^*M$.

source.place: Proof: the termwise identification is compatible with differentials; unit proof: exact functors preserving direct summands. Makes precise restriction of the coefficient dual, completed tensor, and their evaluation before the local bounded-complex argument.
